post.description: Test mode only. Deletes every row (users, sessions, holds, orders and scenario data included), resets the clock (or freezes it at `freezeAt`) and inserts the baseline seed for the clock date. The swap is atomic: other requests see the old data or the new baseline, never a half-empty database. Affects every client of this server, so it needs `X-Test-Key` when the server has a test API key.

info.title: TestTix API
info.description: REST API of TestTix, a sample event ticket shop for software testing practice. Errors are `application/problem+json`; every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header.

csrfToken.description: Send it in the `X-CSRF-Token` header of every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE

email.description: Email address. Surrounding spaces are removed and it is matched case-insensitively.

name.description: Display name. Surrounding spaces are removed.

emailVerified.description: Unverified users can log in but not check out

expiresAt.description: When the session ends if unused (server clock). Each authenticated request moves it forward.

email.description: Email address. Surrounding spaces are removed and it is matched case-insensitively.

status.description: `down` if the dependency failed or timed out
`down` if the dependency failed or timed out

now.description: Server "now" as an ISO 8601 date-time in UTC

mode.description: `real`: the real time. `frozen`: stopped at `now`. `offset`: running, shifted by `offsetMs`.

offsetMs.description: Server "now" minus the real time, in milliseconds (0 in `real` mode)

freezeAt.description: Stop the clock at this ISO 8601 date-time (with `Z` or an offset, e.g. `2026-12-01T19:30:00Z`). It stays there until advanced or reset.

advanceBy.description: Move the clock forward by this many milliseconds (at most 366 days per call). A frozen clock stays frozen at the later time; a running clock keeps running.

reset.description: `true` to go back to the real time.

freezeAt.description: Freeze the clock at this ISO 8601 date-time (with `Z` or an offset) instead of resetting it to the real time. The data is then seeded relative to this date, so every reset with the same `freezeAt` day gives identical data.

ResetRequestDto.description: Optional. Send no body (or `{}`) to reset the clock to the real time.

seedDay.description: UTC date the seed data is relative to (`D` in the testing guide): the clock date

now.description: Server "now" as an ISO 8601 date-time in UTC

mode.description: `real`: the real time. `frozen`: stopped at `now`. `offset`: running, shifted by `offsetMs`.

offsetMs.description: Server "now" minus the real time, in milliseconds (0 in `real` mode)

clock.description: The server clock after the reset

rows.description: Rows inserted per table. Every other table is empty.

capacity.description: GA sections only: how many places

tickets.description: Inventory units (seats and GA places) of the event, by status

concert.description: Seated section and a GA section

ScenarioBuyer_Output.description: The customer who bought the sold tickets. Has no password: you cannot log in as them.

orderIds.description: The confirmed orders that bought every ticket
The confirmed orders that bought the other seats

seat.description: The one seat that is still available

email.description: Email of the new user. Default: `user-<random>@session.testtix.test`. 409 `email-already-registered` if taken.

password.description: Lets the user also log in through `POST /auth/login` (e.g. a UI test of the login form). Without it the user has no password and only this session.

emailVerified.description: Default `true`. Unverified users can log in but not check out.

csrfToken.description: Value of the `testtix_csrf` cookie; send it in `X-CSRF-Token` too

cookie.description: A ready-made `Cookie` request header with both cookies, for clients without a cookie jar

type.description: URI that identifies the problem type: `about:blank` or `urn:testtix:problem:<error-code>`

title.description: Short summary of the problem type

requestId.description: Same value as the `X-Request-Id` response header

path.description: Dot-separated path of the invalid field, e.g. `items.0.quantity`. Empty for the root.

errors.description: Field errors. Empty unless the request failed validation.
